# TC.SectionInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SectionInfo"></a>

### TC.SectionInfo

This record gives complete native section readback.
The index is a position, not a stable identity.
Removal of an earlier section shifts later indexes.
The filter array contains occupied slots in native slot order.
It includes sparse slot indexes explicitly.
The native capacity filters_count is not the number of populated array entries.

Nonmanual sections are readable but protected.
Shared-group filters require explicit local detachment before writes.
Multiplier readback preserves native float32 rounding.

### active

Current section enabled state.

```text
boolean
```

### capabilities

Dynamic active/group/multiplier/filters capabilities and reasons.

```text
table<string, TC.FieldSchema>
```

### filters

Complete populated normalized indexed filters.

```text
(TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter)[]
```

### filters_count

Native slot capacity, separately bounded by section_filters.

```text
integer
```

### group

Shared-group name. An empty name means local.

```text
string
```

### index

Native one-based current section index.

```text
integer
```

### is_manual

Whether native manual editing is permitted.

```text
boolean
```

### multiplier

Finite native multiplier readback, not a decimal-rounding promise.

```text
number
```

### type

```text

```
